nodes.name: Theorem 3.5: Information Preservation 1 of
nodes.statement:
Suppose 1, 2 hold with constants $c,C>0$.
            Fix a permutation $w_1^\star,w_2^\star,\dots,w_k^\star$ of the vectors $\ensuremath{\left\{w_i^\star:1\leq i\leq k\right\}}$.
            The following hold. 
            \begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=15pt]
                \item \textit{(Information Preservation)}
                    For any matrices $V,W\in \mathbb{R}^{d\times k}$ that are $O\ensuremath{\left(\nicefrac{1}{\log{k}}\right)}$-warm starts for ${W^\star}$, 
                    \[
                        \operatorname{d}_{\mathsf{TV}}{\ensuremath{\left(\euscr{M}(V),~\euscr{M}(W)\right)}} \geq 
                        \ensuremath{\left(\frac{c}{ek}\right)}^{{O({C^2/c^2}){}}}
                        \cdot \relax{V - W}_F\,.
                        \addtocounter{equation}{1}\tag{\theequation}
                    \]
                \item \textit{(Local Convexity)} For any matrix $W\in \mathbb{R}^{d\times k}$ that is a $\mathrm{poly}\ensuremath{\left(\nicefrac{1}{k}\right)}$-warm start for ${W^\star}$, 
                    \[
                        \grad^2 \ensuremath{\mathscr{L}}(W) \succeq 0\,.
                    \]
            \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 5.1: Reduction to ``Conditional'' Information Preservation tabular p 0 01cm @ p 7cm @ $\beta$ …
nodes.statement:
For a non-empty set $\ensuremath{\mathscr{E}}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, 
            \[
                \operatorname{d}_{\mathsf{TV}}{\ensuremath{\left(\euscr{M}(V),~\euscr{M}(W)\right)}} 
                \geq 
                \Pr_{x\sim \euscr{N}{\ensuremath{\left(0,I\right)}}}[x\in\ensuremath{\mathscr{E}}]\cdot \operatorname{d}_{\mathsf{TV}}{\ensuremath{\left(\euscr{M}(V\mid \ensuremath{\mathscr{E}}),~\euscr{M}(W\mid \ensuremath{\mathscr{E}})\right)}}\,,
            \]
            where $\euscr{M}(V\mid \ensuremath{\mathscr{E}})$ (respectively $\euscr{M}(W\mid \ensuremath{\mathscr{E}})$) is the distribution of $(x,y_{\max})\sim \euscr{M}(V)$ (respectively $(x,y_{\max})\sim \euscr{M}(W)$) conditioned on $x\in \ensuremath{\mathscr{E}}$.

nodes.name: Theorem 5.6: Strong Convexity Near ${W^\star}$
nodes.statement:
For $\rho\in(0,k^{-\Omega(B^2)})$, $t=\rho\cdot \widetilde{O}\ensuremath{\left(\frac{1}{C^2B^4k^{17/2}}\right)}$, and $V\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times k}$ satisfying $\relax{V}_F=1$, 
    define
    \[
        W_t\coloneqq W^\star+tV\,.
    \]
    Then, 
    \[
        \boldsymbol\NABLA^2 \ensuremath{\mathscr{L}}(W_t) 
        \succeq 
        \boldsymbol\NABLA^2 \ensuremath{\mathscr{L}}(W^\star)
            - (\rho + k^{-\Omega(B^2)}) I\,.
    \]
nodes.section: Figure 8: Outline of Proof of Local Convexity for Self-Selection.

nodes.name: Lemma 5.7
nodes.statement:
For $\zeta\in(0,1)$ and $t=\zeta\cdot O\ensuremath{\left(\frac{1}{B^4k^3}\right)}$, 
\[
    \forall_{x\in \mathbb{R}^d}\,,~\forall_{y_{\max}\in \mathbb{R}}\,,\quad 
    \boldsymbol\NABLA^2 \ensuremath{\mathscr{L}}(W_t;x,y_{\max}) - \boldsymbol\NABLA^2 \ensuremath{\mathscr{L}}(W_0;x,y_{\max}) \succeq -\upgamma(x,y_{\max}) \cdot I_{k}\otimes xx^\top\,,
\]
where
\[ 
    \upgamma(x,y_{\max}) \coloneqq 
        80 k^2\cdot
        \Bigl(\zeta + e^{-B^2 k/2}\Bigr)\cdot
        \Bigl(1 + y_{\max}^4 + \max\ensuremath{\{\|W_t^\top x\|_\infty, \|W_0^\top x\|_\infty\}}^4\Bigr)
        \,.
\]
nodes.section: Figure 8: Outline of Proof of Local Convexity for Self-Selection.

nodes.name: Lemma 5.8
nodes.statement:
For 
    $\zeta\in (0, 1)$, 
    $t=\zeta\cdot O\ensuremath{\left(\frac{1}{B^4k^3}\right)}$,
    and $\upgamma$ as in 5.7,
    \[
        0\preceq \operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}_{x,y_{\max}}\Bigl[\upgamma(x,y_{\max}) \cdot I_{k}\otimes xx^\top \Bigr] \preceq 
        C
            \cdot \widetilde{O}(k^{11/2})
            \cdot (\zeta + e^{-B^2 k/2})
            \cdot I_{dk}\,.
    \]

nodes.name: Lemma 5.13: Bounds on Conditional Expectations
nodes.statement:
For $\zeta\in [0,1)$ and $t\leq \zeta \cdot O\ensuremath{\left(\frac{1}{B^4k^3}\right)}$,
           \begin{align*}
               \left| \textup{eq:SS:LC:ub1} \right|
                    &~~\leq~~ \zeta
                    \cdot \sqrt{\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v, z\right\rangle^4]}}\,,\\
                \left| \textup{eq:SS:LC:ub2} \right|
                    &~~\leq~~ 
                    e^{-B^2 k/2}\cdot
                    \ensuremath{\left( 
                        \sqrt{\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{t}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v, z\right\rangle^4]}}
                        +
                        \sqrt{\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v, z\right\rangle^4]}}
                    \right)}\,,\\[-1mm]
                \left| \textup{eq:SS:LC:ub3} \right|
                    &~~\leq~~ \zeta
                    \cdot \ensuremath{\left(\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[{\left\langle v, z\right\rangle}^2]}\right)}^2\,,\\
                \left| \textup{eq:SS:LC:ub4} \right|
                    &~~\leq ~~
                    e^{-B^2 k}\cdot
                    \ensuremath{\left(
                        {\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{t}\ensuremath{[{\left\langle v, z\right\rangle}^4]}}
                        +
                        {\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[{\left\langle v, z\right\rangle}^4]}}
                    \right)}\,,\\
                \left| \textup{eq:SS:LC:ub5} \right|
                    &~~\leq~~ 2e^{-B^2 k/2}\cdot
                    \ensuremath{\left(
                        {\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{t}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v, z\right\rangle^2]}}
                        +
                        {\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v, z\right\rangle^2]}}
                    \right)}\,.
           \end{align*}

nodes.name: Lemma 5.14: Bounds on Unconditional Expectations
nodes.statement:
It holds that 
            \begin{align*}
                 \operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{t}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v,z\right\rangle^2\mid z\in P]} &\leq 
                 2k\ensuremath{\left(1 + \left| y_{\max} \right| + \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\| W_t^\top x \|}}_\infty\right)}^2
                 ~\text{and}~
                 \operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{t}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v,z\right\rangle^4\mid z\in P]} &\leq 
                 3k^2\ensuremath{\left(1 + \left| y_{\max} \right| + \ensuremath{\ensuremath{\| W_t^\top x \|}}_\infty\right)}^4\,.
            \end{align*}
            Substituting $t=0$, gives upper bounds on $\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v,z\right\rangle^2]}$ and $\operatornamewithlimits{\mathbb{E}}\nolimits_{0}\ensuremath{[\left\langle v,z\right\rangle^4]}$.
